values.TIP (tightening procedures): Cylinder head bolt Tighten all the cylinder head bolts evenly in the tightening order to 36 N·m (3.6 kgf·m, 27 lb·ft). Remove the one bolt according to the tightening order. When doing so, do not loosen the other bolts. Retighten the bolt to 18 N·m (1.8 kgf·m, 13 lb·ft), and then tighten it further to reach the specified angle (90°). Remove the remaining bolts one by one in the same manner and retighten them.
